principle: Work is ordered by decision leverage. Tasks that cannot change the next release decision are deferred, not deleted.
current_release_target: Gate04E mechanical/design-definition closure for the current K01 module

priority_bands.title: Protect the frozen design state
priority_bands.purpose: Do not reopen geometry without contrary evidence.
priority_bands.policy: These nodes protect the current geometry/service case. A change here invalidates downstream product definition.

priority_bands.title: Production technical definition
priority_bands.purpose: Turn the already-built design into an unambiguous manufacturable definition.
priority_bands.policy: This is the current primary workstream. MBD is preferred machine-readable storage, but reviewed semantic bindings to native CAD may be used as an explicit transitional authority. Drawings never invent tolerances.

priority_bands.title: Release-critical product requirements
priority_bands.purpose: Close service, containment and acceptance requirements that geometry alone cannot close.
priority_bands.policy: These remain product-release blockers even when CAD/FEA are green.

priority_bands.title: Magnetic quantitative acceptance
priority_bands.purpose: Convert current FEMM field screening into final quantitative/bench evidence when release acceptance requires it.
priority_bands.policy: Current field/automation evidence is retained. Absolute force extraction is reopened when it can change actuator acceptance or for final bench correlation.

priority_bands.title: Independent solver assurance
priority_bands.purpose: CalculiX cross-check of the already-passing SolidWorks service case.
priority_bands.policy: DEFERRED_ASSURANCE for the current release path. Reopen if the structural assumptions, geometry, load/contact model materially change, or if the primary analysis no longer has a clearly large margin.

system_assurance.policy: Important MEDTAS/MBD assurance, but not allowed to displace the current product-definition critical path unless a semantic-drift or definition-ambiguity condition is detected.
